title: The Engine Heart
text: Deep in the ruins a great engine still turns, its pistons sighing, its furnace burning with no fuel at all. Its heart is a sphere of light no one could carry. Someone has tried: their gloves are still welded to it, and a little of their shape is burned into the floor.

options.label: The cleverest tinkers with the engine, hoping to coax a gift from its heart.

outcomes.text: After a careful turn here and a tap there, the engine gives up a gift of worked iron and a breath of essence.
At the first careful turn it explodes in light and heat, burning a little of their shape into the floor.

options.label: The strongest shuts it down, and ends a thousand years of turning.

outcomes.text: The light dies. Somewhere in the Forge Ruins, something stops working and is glad to rest.

options.label: Leave it turning. Whoever tried to take its heart is a warning enough.

outcomes.text: It turns on, as it has for a thousand years. Its heat settles in the Leader's bones, quickening their hands for the next fight.

options.label: The Conjurer drinks from its light, thirsty for power that burns so bright.

outcomes.text: It pours into them like a river, and it goes on pouring for days.
It pours in without stopping, burning all the way down.
